name: Doctrine of Embellishment
body:
Embellishment is where most of the power of stories comes from. Too many facts can be boring. The doctrine of the embellishment focuses on some trickery and glibness. You gain the following abilities.

Malleable Truth (Ex)

You become immune to any magical effect that would magically detect that you are lying or would prevent you from lying (such as zone of truth). In addition, you can Use your Wisdom modifier instead of your Charisma modifier for non-combat Bluff checks.

Twisting Truths (Su)

With your oratory performances, you can twist narratives and truths to throw a target’s mind into disarray. At 16th level, while you are using inspire courage, you can use a point of faith to impose confusion on a target withing 30 feet that can see and hear you. The target must make a Will save (DC 10 + 1/2 the legendary cleric’s level + their Charisma mod) or be confused while the performance is maintained. The target can make a Will save at the end of each of its rounds to break free. Once the target makes their saving throw, either initially or while affected by confusion, is dazed until the beginning of their next turn. This is a mind-affecting effect.
